pages.title: Beep, beep · 1/3
paragraphs: It is Sunday morning in a big supermarket in Portland. The regular lines are long and slow. Duda has a small basket and little time. She sees a row of self-checkout machines. A friendly employee named Mel stands near them. Duda walks up to her.
“Excuse me, how does this machine work?” says Mel. “It is easy. First, scan each item.” says Mel. “Like this? It doesn’t beep.” says Mel.

pages.title: Beep, beep · 3/3
paragraphs: “Yes. Touch it to the screen. Don’t forget the receipt.” says Mel. “Thank you so much. That is easy.” says Mel. Duda scans the milk, the bread and the cheese. She weighs the apples on the scale. The screen says “Total: eleven dollars”. She touches her card and the machine beeps. She takes the receipt and puts her bags on her arm. New machines are easy with a little help.
